purpose: Explore local structured data through bounded observations and reusable fixed results. The caller chooses the questions and judges the evidence.
start: rowtrail schema METHOD (only for an unfamiliar operation)
workflow: Open CSV/TSV/Parquet; keep the response binding and fields. Open does not perform a full profile.
Request only needed inspect columns/checks. Query with explicit bindings and typed parameters.
Check ok, then job.state. Read an included observation directly; do not fetch it again.
For follow-up SQL, bind result_ref plus a fixed revision. Keep large tables outside model context.
For progressive Parquet count/sum/avg, use analyze. Its observations cover only the reported prefix; ordinary SQL is preferable for final-only answers.
A fresh conversation can discover existing bindings and active jobs with workspace summary. Pass its cursor unchanged to get the next page.
Use control wait/status/cancel and durable events. Mechanical waiting needs no model. Disconnecting does not cancel accepted work.
Release unused results, inspect workspace gc dry-run, then explicitly apply collection. Retained descendants protect their inputs.
quality: Read accuracy, coverage, final_for_request and presentation separately. Completing a query on a partial result does not make its original-source coverage complete.
numbers: Int64, UInt64 and Decimal values are JSON strings with declared schema types. Preserve exact arithmetic. Progressive avg is Decimal128(38,6), truncated toward zero.
budgets: Waiting, computation, memory, scanning, stored results and output have separate limits. Engine memory is not a process RSS hard cap.
retry: After ambiguous transport failure, inspect durable state or deliberately reuse the original idempotency key. Never silently replay a possibly accepted mutation.
capabilities: Use doctor for the running coordinator's actual capabilities. A still-running old coordinator retains its old version. No internal model calls or automatic host resume.
composition: The optional stdlib Python client offers open(source), query(sql, bindings), binding(response), observe(response), and guarded rows(response). Compose known steps in code; query waits mechanically without replay and preserves full observations. Raw call(method, params) remains available.
